segmentation.text: Every person operating a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter
(a) When traveling at a lawful rate of speed
(c) When doing so would not be safe,
ride as near to the right side of the roadway
when passing a standing vehicle or one proceeding in the same direction.

For purposes of paragraph (c) of subsection 1, the conditions under which it is not safe to operate a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter as near to the right side of the roadway as practicable include, without limitation:
(a) When fixed or moving objects, parked or moving vehicles, bicycles, pedestrians, animals or surface hazards impede access to the right side of the roadway.
(b) When a lane is too narrow for a bicycle and a vehicle to travel safely side by side within the lane.

elements.justification: Admitted aggregates of the three defined terms, each claimed as one ru.aggregate atom ('membership of a legal aggregate'), never expanded into classes; 'person operating' is read through the device's controlled motion (agency reading), not as a role atom, which the aggregate's 'not a stand-in for' clause excludes.

'upon a roadway': st.roadway is 'the part of a highway improved for vehicular traffic, excluding shoulder', the extent of DEF-NRS-484A-220 'that portion of a highway which is improved and ordinarily used for vehicular traffic, exclusive of the shoulder'; rel.occupies anchors the subject ('a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region'), as the index maps 'upon a roadway shall, except:' (NRS_484B_777_1_o2). 'shall, except:' introduces the exceptions of this roadway duty. The words of exception (b) name no place for the left turn; a left turn off a roadway is made where it meets another way, so the declared intention is read at every kind of region where that happens: st.intersection ('the region where two roadways meet') and st.driveway_or_alley_entrance ('private road, alley or driveway meeting the highway'), the latter covering every alley, driveway and private road entrance.

'traffic' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic ('pedestrians, ridden or herded animals, vehicles and other conveyances either singly or together using any highway for purposes of travel'), one ru.aggregate atom. 'any nearby traffic' is every road user of that aggregate, other than the subject, whose body gap to the subject (rel.surface_gap, 'distance between the nearest points of two bodies') is within the nearby reach, whatever its direction of travel; where none is nearby the comparison holds vacuously ('any'), the subject then holding back no traffic. surface_gap is the body gap itself, not a centre distance.

The right side of the roadway is its right edge: st.road_edge, 'curb or edge of the roadway', lying on the same highway (st.on_way: 'the public way (a highway region) a structure region lies on'; st.highway its kind) as the roadway the subject occupies (rel.occupies, st.roadway). Nearness is the gap between the subject's body and that edge: prim.region_lateral_offset is 'the signed lateral offset (m, left positive) of a structure region from a road user', negative for an edge on the right, less half the subject's width from kin.extent ('a formula reads the full length, width and height'); st.region_geometry carries the edge's outline the primitive reads, and its 'not a stand-in for occupancy' clause does not apply, occupancy being read by rel.occupies. Same family of atoms as the index's 'drive to the extreme right side of the highway' (NRS_484B_627_1a), here on the roadway's edge.

Things that impede access to the right side: 'fixed or moving objects', 'animals' and 'surface hazards' are st.obstruction, 'a physical object on or beside the roadway that is not a road user; kind in {debris, excavation, hose, barrier, stalled_vehicle_wreckage, sidewalk_fixture, mail_drop_box, other}' (an animal that is not ridden or herded is such an object, kind other); 'parked or moving vehicles', 'bicycles' and 'pedestrians' are the admitted aggregates DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, DEF-NRS-484A-025::bicycle and DEF-NRS-484A-165::pedestrian, whatever their motion. Impeding access is the thing lying in the rider's way on its right side: for an object, ahead of the subject along the designated direction of the roadway it occupies within the reach (prim.region_offset_along, 'the signed distance (m) from a road user's reference point to a structure region ... measured along a carrier's designated direction (st.lane_direction)', from zero to the reach) and at or to the right of the subject (prim.region_lateral_offset at or below zero), its outline being st.region_geometry; for a road user, the body gap (rel.surface_gap, 'distance between the nearest points of two bodies') within the reach, ahead and at or to the right of the subject (rel.bearing, 'direction of b from a in a's frame'). Neither atom is used for a clearance it excludes: surface_gap is the body gap itself; bearing is a direction only.

operationalizations.standard: a rate of speed commensurate with the speed of nearby traffic
operationalizations.convention: Traveling is the subject's speed (kin.speed) above the source's speed resolution (p.halt_speed_tolerance). The subject's speed is commensurate with the nearby traffic (s4b: traffic road users within p.nearby_traffic_reach, two seconds of headway at urban speed) where each such road user's speed exceeds the subject's by no more than p.commensurate_speed_margin, a speed differential within one traffic stream; the bound moves with both measured speeds.

operationalizations.standard: when doing so would not be safe
operationalizations.convention: Not safe is read through the two conditions subsection 2 names: (a) an object, vehicle, bicycle or pedestrian on the subject's right within p.right_side_impede_reach (s13), the distance within which a rider must steer around it; (b) the lane the subject occupies narrower than p.shared_lane_min_width (s14), the wide-outside-lane width of bicycle facility guidance below which a bicycle and a motor vehicle cannot share a lane side by side.

operationalizations.standard: as near to the right side of the roadway as practicable
operationalizations.convention: As near as practicable is a gap between the subject's body and the roadway's right edge of at most p.bicycle_keep_right_gap: a bicyclist's shy distance from a curb or edge plus the sway of its operating space and the source's position error (AASHTO bicycle operating space).

operationalizations.standard: the conditions under which it is not safe ... include, without limitation
operationalizations.convention: The catch-all 'include, without limitation' is read only through the contracts s13 and s14 read: obstructions and road users of the named aggregates on the subject's right within p.right_side_impede_reach, and a lane narrower than p.shared_lane_min_width.

operationalizations.standard: a lane too narrow for a bicycle and a vehicle to travel safely side by side within the lane
operationalizations.convention: The lane the subject occupies (rel.occupies, st.lane) has a width (st.lane_width, 'width of a lane at a point') below p.shared_lane_min_width: 14 ft, the lane width below which bicycle facility guidance (AASHTO, MUTCD shared-lane guidance) holds that a bicycle and a motor vehicle cannot travel safely side by side within one lane; the bicycle and the vehicle are the design road users the width stands for, not road users present in the scene.

intentions.meaning: the source's current plan for the road user includes a turn to the left at the target region, the plan's preparation for that turn included

applicability: The subject is a member of the bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter aggregate and its footprint overlaps a roadway at the observation, and none of the exceptions holds there: (a) the subject is traveling (speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance), complies with NRS_484B_785_1a (its lawful speed: the accepted record that an electric scooter on a roadway or bicycle lane or path travels at no more than its stated speed; a subject it does not engage complies), and every road user of the traffic aggregate other than the subject whose body gap to it is within p.nearby_traffic_reach has a speed no greater than the subject's plus p.commensurate_speed_margin (vacuously true where no such road user is nearby); (b) for some intersection or driveway/alley entrance r, the source's declaration current at the observation states int.left_turn for the subject at r; (c) not safe: some obstruction o lies ahead of the subject within p.right_side_impede_reach along the designated direction of a roadway the subject occupies (prim.region_offset_along from zero to the reach) with a lateral offset from the subject at or below zero (on its right or overlapping its line), or some road user of the vehicle, bicycle or pedestrian aggregate other than the subject has a body gap to the subject within p.right_side_impede_reach and a bearing whose longitudinal component is positive and lateral component at or below zero, or the subject occupies a lane whose width is below p.shared_lane_min_width.
obligation: At the observation the subject rides as near the right side of the roadway as practicable: with r a roadway the subject occupies, for some road edge e lying on a highway on which r lies, with e's lateral offset from the subject negative (on its right), the magnitude of that offset less half the subject's width (kin.extent) is at most p.bicycle_keep_right_gap. Where no road edge on a highway of r lies on the subject's right in the scene, or the offset is unobserved, the verdict is unknown (definedWhen), never violated.

narrowings.why: 'person operating' is read through the device's controlled motion on the roadway, whoever controls it.

The catch-all 'include, without limitation' is read only through the contracts s13 and s14 read: obstructions, and road users of the vehicle, bicycle and pedestrian aggregates, in the rider's way on its right, and a lane narrower than the shared-lane width; other unsafe conditions, among them road users of no named aggregate (electric bicycles and electric scooters, which the vehicle and bicycle definitions leave out), are not read.
The right side is read relative to the subject's heading (the primitive's frame), and the edge is a mapped road edge on a highway the occupied roadway lies on.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A bicycle rides at 5 m/s on a roadway whose outside lane is 5.0 m wide, its body 2.5 m from the right road edge; a car of the vehicle and traffic aggregates travels the same way at 13 m/s with a body gap of 20 m behind it; no obstruction or other road user is on its right, no intersection or driveway entrance is in the scene, so no left turn is declared.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but the bicycle rides with its body 0.6 m from the right road edge.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: A bicycle rides on a sidewalk, its footprint overlapping no roadway.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but the source maps regions without their outlines, so the road edge's lateral offset from the bicycle is unobserved.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: A bicycle rides alone at 5 m/s in the middle of a 5.0 m outside lane; no other road user is in the scene, so exception (a) holds vacuously: the duty binds the subject alone and is decided.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but the outside lane is 3.5 m wide, below the shared-lane width (exception (c), s14).

scenarios.name: branch_3
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but a parked car of the vehicle aggregate stands 10 m ahead of the bicycle on its right, at the curb (exception (c), s13).

scenarios.name: branch_4
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, but an intersection lies ahead and the source declares int.left_turn for the bicycle at it (exception (b)).

scenarios.name: branch_5
scenarios.narrative: An electric scooter rides at 8 m/s, above the speed NRS_484B_785_1a allows it, 2.5 m from the right edge of a 5.0 m lane; a car travels the same way at 9 m/s 20 m behind it: its speed is commensurate but not lawful, so exception (a) fails.
